claim: The book teaches 袋 as a word read ふくろ (bag) in its supermarket expressions, and the cut phrase says 袋 is carded on its own, but the shipped 袋 card is a silent character card from KANJIDIC rather than the word ふくろ with its audio, as the deck does for 雨, 雪, 夏, 冬, 所 and 肉.
evidence: Book, Useful Expressions (スーパーで): "<ruby>袋<rt>ふくろ</rt></ruby>をお願いします。 Can I have a bag?". Excluded r-27d59e1426e0 袋をお願いします: "Its words are carded on their own: 袋." Shipped r-cc98544dbc8a: 袋, "Bag", pronunciation "tai / fukuro", reviewNote "Not taught by the book yet: meaning and readings from KANJIDIC2", no ttsText, no audio.
fix: Make r-cc98544dbc8a the word card: reading ふくろ copied from the book, romaji fukuro, audio, English "Bag", like the single-kanji words 雨 and 雪 in this unit.
verdictReason: Checked. Book p.(Useful Expressions, スーパーで) prints 袋をお願いします with furigana ふくろ and gloss "Can I have a bag?", so the chapter teaches the word 袋 (ふくろ). The words-only cut (baaab52) excluded the phrase with the reason "Its words are carded on their own: 袋", but the only 袋 card in the collection (r-cc98544dbc8a; chapter-11 has 手袋 only) is a generated character card: candidates/characters.json lists it as source "dictionary", usedIn [袋をお願いします], voiced false; the rendered back is "Bag / Says: tai / fukuro" with no audio, and the card has no ttsText. Reading rule 4 (docs/card-rules-reading.md, 04-card-rules.md) says a single character the book also teaches as a word is one card, the word, with its audio; rule 6 says each taught word of a cut phrase is still a card. Neither is met: the learner is graded on the meaning alone and never on reading 袋 as ふくろ. Severity raised from polish to should-fix because the cut claims coverage that a character card does not provide, and no card tests the word. The Reader comparison to 雨, 雪, 夏, 冬, 所, 肉 is loose (those are vocabulary-table words), but rule 4 settles it on its own. Fix must also update candidates/characters.json (the 袋 entry under cards and the characters list) so the voiced word card is not re-treated as a kanji card by the book pass, and needs new TTS at the audio gate. For the synthesizer: the same mechanism resolved 手, 熱, 時, 体, 話, 後, 二, 道, 角 and 背 in other chapters to character cards; not verified here.
